label: Run Recurring Job
mcp_tool_description: Run a CloudBolt recurring job immediately, outside its schedule, exactly like Run Now on the Recurring Jobs page; a disabled job still runs. Give the recurring job's global id (RJB-...) or exact name. Returns jobId to poll with fetch_job_log. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
